test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of August 2022, under the Naya Savera Scheme, only candidates belonging to the notified Minority Communities, having the total family income from all sources NOT exceeding ________ per annum, will be eligible under the Scheme.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 6 lakh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The scheme **aims to empower students belonging to minority communities and prepare them for competitive examinations so that their participation in government and private jobs improves.**
 
• The scheme provides financial support for free coaching to notified minority students in selected coaching institutions.
 
• ** The total family income** from all sources **NOT exceeding Rs. 6 lahks per annum**, will be eligible under the Scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Qualifying examinations for admission in technical/professional courses such as **engineering, law, medicine, management, information technolog**y etc and language/aptitude examinations for seeking admission in foreign universities.
 
• Coaching for jobs in the private sector such as in** airlines, shipping, information technology (IT), business process outsourcing (BPO) and other IT-enabled services, hospitality, tours and travels, maritime, food processing, retail, sales & marketing, biotechnology** and other job oriented courses as per the emerging trend of employment.
 
• Remedial coaching at the undergraduate and postgraduate level to improve academic knowledge and enable the student to catch up with the rest of the class and complete the course successfully.
